comparison.policy: Compare matched exact scenario versions and repetitions. All planned cases, including failed outputs, remain in the denominator. Method/model/trace/retrieval/labels never enter the scorer. No automatic winner or overall weighted quality score.

result.notice: Pass means the listed rules passed. Inconclusive means rules cannot establish the criterion. These results are not AI judgments or proof of semantic quality.

rules.usefulness: One nonrepeated question, <=40 words; reflection/learning/approach/planning cue; no listed coercive wording. These are form and wording rules, not measured educational benefit.
rules.context_fit: ICT scenario, no unsupported named technology, shared content words with scenario evidence. No lexical anchor is inconclusive. Bank applicability conditions, method and model never affect the score.
rules.correctness: Check recognized completion/incorrect-answer claims and named technologies against scenario evidence. Unsupported claims are flags. No recognized, testable claim is inconclusive; lack of a flag does not establish truth.

usefulness.zero_division: Undefined precision, recall and class F1 are 0; fixed Yes/No classes always included
